name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach the belt to the weight and stand on the platforms with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Drive through your feet to stand.
The load hangs from your hips, so your spine is not loaded.
image_prompt_scene: Standing on platforms with the weight belt hanging from the hips.
